name: Eleven Flash v2
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Speech (HTTP, stream, WebSocket, multi-context WebSocket)
ElevenAgents (agent TTS model; the default for a new agent)

voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model. WebSocket input is flushed with flush: true at the end of an agent turn [el-ws-tts]
voice.interruption: Not handled by the model. The multi-context WebSocket lets a client close one context and open another when a user cuts in, with up to 5 contexts per connection [el-ws-multi]
voice.latency: About 75 ms model inference, excluding application and network latency [el-models]; the WebSocket time-to-first-byte figures the docs give for Flash models are 100 to 200 ms by region [el-latency-opt]
voice.session_limit: 30,000 characters per request, about 30 minutes of audio [el-models]; the WebSocket closes after 20 seconds of inactivity unless the client sends a space; a multi-context socket allows up to 180 seconds [el-ws-tts] [el-ws-multi]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.04 per 1,000 characters, shared with Flash v2.5 and the deprecated Turbo models on the pricing page [el-pricing-api]; the launch post says 1 credit per 2 characters [el-blog-flash]

benchmarks.name: Maker model inference latency (milliseconds)
benchmarks.setting: approximate figure, excluding application and network latency

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; the limit is in characters, see voice.session_limit
max_output: not published in tokens; the per-request limit is 30,000 characters [el-models]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1,000 characters), see notes
system_card: the maker publishes no system card or model card in the pages read

released: the maker's launch post gives 2024-12-18, the date Artificial Analysis lists for Flash v2.5; the changelog entry that announces Flash is dated 2024-12-19 [el-blog-flash] [el-changelog-flash]
